footnotes.text: Joseph F. Smith,Notes on Elijah Able, undated [likely circa 1879], Church History Library, Salt Lake City. Able was characterized as octoroon (one-eighth black) according to nomenclature used at the time.
Mary Ann, like Elijah, was one-eighth black. Smith,Notes on Elijah Able.

The 1870 census indicates the Ables had seven children living in their household, though it is not clear whether they were all children of Elijah and Mary Ann.United States Census, 1870,FamilySearch.org.
